reply.text:
Rough morning, and I won't pretend otherwise. Water and food first, and give yourself a bit of time before you train. If you do want to move, a light session is a sensible call: keep the weights well under what you'd normally use, skip anything maximal, and stop early if you feel worse rather than better.

I can pull up today's session from your program and tell you what's on it, so you can decide whether it suits how you feel. Want me to check?
